areasOfLaw.intro: For more than 30 years, clients in Calgary and throughout Alberta have trusted Fric, Lowenstein & Co. LLP for prudent, customer-focused legal representation. No matter what your specific legal needs may be, our analytical team will work tirelessly to defend your rights. Contact our team to discuss your specific situation. We help people with services related to:

faq.intro: Learn more about Fric, Lowenstein & Co. LLP's Calgary-based legal practice. We have been serving individuals and businesses throughout Alberta since 1982.

faqs.question: How long has Fric, Lowenstein & Co. LLP been in practice?
faqs.answer: Fric, Lowenstein & Co. LLP has more than 40 years of experience serving the legal needs of citizens in Calgary and throughout Alberta. Founded in 1982, our firm has built lasting relationships with individuals, families, and businesses across the province.

faqs.question: Do I have a case?
faqs.answer:
Every situation is unique. Contact us today to discuss your specific circumstances — we are committed to defending the rights of our clients.

We regularly help people who are: buying or selling a residential or commercial property; starting or operating a small business; concerned about will and estate planning; dealing with a foreclosure or mortgage issue; seeking debt collection or creditor remedies; recovering from a personal injury; or in need of general legal guidance.

faqs.question: What areas of law does the firm practice?
faqs.answer: Our firm offers a broad range of legal services including: real estate — sales, purchases and mortgages; wills and estates; corporate and small business law; civil and commercial litigation; foreclosures; debt collection; commercial transactions; personal injury (contingency fee available); banking and private lending; and notarization and commissioning.

faqs.question: Can I call for a free initial telephone discussion?
faqs.answer: Yes. We will take your initial call at no charge and let you know whether we can assist with your matter. For areas outside our practice — such as criminal or family law — we work closely with other trusted lawyers and can provide a direct referral. If it is a matter we can handle ourselves, we will give you a clear estimate of anticipated costs before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you offer flat-rate or fixed-fee services?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer discounted flat rates for many routine legal services including real estate transactions, incorporations, wills, and notarizations. See our Pricing page for the current fee schedule, or call us for a quote on more complex matters.

faqs.question: Where is your office located?
faqs.answer: We are conveniently located at #750, 11012 Macleod Trail S.E., Calgary, Alberta T2J 7E4 — Southcentre Executive Tower. Easy to get to and easy to park. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM.
